svg.text: Hover a cell for recall, precision, the number of functions and the corpus. A cell is agreement with the oracle's reading of the family's contract on one corpus, not proof the family is right everywhere.

Oracles: Python ast and tree-sitter (tests/tools/family_oracle.py, family_oracle_ts.py). Families in italics have a draft contract. Languages without a tree-sitter grammar (COBOL, JCL, assembler, ...) need another oracle.
